# Butler v0.0.14

## Change Log

- Restored the packaged Butler App update path so installed apps can discover
  the latest public App release instead of comparing only against their local
  installed metadata. This makes Settings report the real available App and
  bundled Agent version again. (#36)
- Made the App update button lead to a visible macOS installer handoff after the
  update package is downloaded, staged, and verified, instead of silently ending
  at a server-side staged state. (#36)
- Tightened App startup behavior around the menu bar helper and Agent service
  launch so relaunches are less likely to spawn duplicate helper/service
  activity while recovering the update path. (#36)
